physics: mixed_execution_v1, picosecond canonical event clock, announced complete workflows
teacher: best of 8192-step annealing from fastest and load plus frozen affinity:anneal256 control; every scored teacher placement retained
features: same execution/eligibility/type/lock/suffix counts/setup/domain/global counts for GNN and MPoff; hand arm adds one- and two-step typed mean aggregation of those base features

training.objective_after_warmup: self-critical full-plan RTT policy gradient +0.1 teacher CE; cost includes one exact descent round; baseline is own greedy plan

serving: construct features, infer assignment, compare its exact cost with fastest and affinity starts, refine the cheapest start for one exact descent round; same decoder for all learned arms
checkpoint_selection: lowest mean validation served RTT, identical for all arms; never select on edge accuracy
primary_bar: GNN improves median environment-paired RTT >=5pct against BOTH MPoff and hand-graph MLP and frozen affinity:anneal256 rule, bootstrap lower95>0 for all; p95 full planning time<=2ms for each GNN draw
test_gate: 64 fresh environments, all nine checkpoints and frozen rule through actual HeROsim, actual Knative diagnostic; source/checkpoint/uniqueness validation and every task completion time audited
scope: single-family three-draw pilot, no distribution-transfer or production SLA claim
logging: offline W&B with persistent checkpoints, contract sidecars and training curves; no external upload
